name: Alga
description: Alga investigations gateway (SSE + REST agent API)

alga.label: Alga
alga.description: Connect OpenClaw to Alga investigations over SSE + REST.

uiHints.label: Alga
uiHints.help: Alga channel provider configuration for SRE investigation routing via SSE and REST agent API.

serverUrl.label: Alga Server URL
serverUrl.help: Base URL of the Alga backend (e.g. https://alga.example.com). No trailing slash.

token.label: Alga Agent Token
token.help: Bot token from the Alga UI (alga_agent_…). Used for SSE and REST authentication.

allowFrom.label: Alga Allowed Users
allowFrom.help: OpenClaw user IDs allowed to use the Alga channel. Leave unset to allow all.

defaultTo.label: Alga Default Target
defaultTo.help: Default conversation target (e.g. alga_dm for operator private chat).
